headline: Agnico Eagle Reports Rock Mass Movement at Canadian Malartic Complex
summary: Agnico Eagle has temporarily suspended mining operations at the Barnat open pit following a rock mass movement, with expected impacts on gold production for 2026 through 2028.

headline: Imperial Metals Receives C$500 Million Canadian Government Support for Red Chris Project
summary: The Canadian federal government has committed C$500 million to support the Red Chris copper-gold project, a joint venture where Newmont is the operator and majority owner.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals to Release 2026 Second Quarter Results on August 6, 2026
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. announced it will release its financial results for the second quarter of 2026 on August 6, 2026, followed by a conference call the next day.

headline: Gold Finder Resources Announces Commencement of Summer Fieldwork at West Madsen Gold Property
summary: Gold Finder Resources Ltd. has initiated its summer 2026 exploration fieldwork at its 100%-owned West Madsen Gold Property in Red Lake, Ontario.

headline: Ghana Cabinet Approves Mining Law Overhaul Affecting Major Gold Producers
summary: The Ghanaian cabinet has approved amendments to the country's mining law, introducing reforms that could impact major gold miners including AngloGold Ashanti.

headline: AngloGold Ashanti Enters Transition Agreement for Mining Services at Iduapriem Mine
summary: AngloGold Ashanti has reached an agreement with Perenti's subsidiary, African Mining Services, for an orderly transition of mining services at the Iduapriem Gold Mine in Ghana.

headline: GoldMining Inc. Files Technical Report and Preliminary Economic Assessment for São Jorge Project
summary: GoldMining Inc. has officially filed a NI 43-101 technical report for its São Jorge gold project in Brazil, detailing a preliminary economic assessment with strong projected economics.

headline: i-80 Gold Corp. Provides Status Update on Lone Tree Plant Refurbishment
summary: i-80 Gold Corp. announced a status update on the refurbishment of its Lone Tree autoclave and carbon-in-leach processing plant in Nevada, confirming the project remains on schedule and on budget.

headline: i-80 Gold Closes $250 Million Royalty Financing with Franco-Nevada
summary: i-80 Gold Corp. has successfully closed a $250 million royalty financing agreement with Franco-Nevada Corporation.
